notes.title: Unicorn Dungeon Update!
notes.content:
​The first update to Unicorn Dungeon is now live!

Changes in this update:

Lighting has been completely redone from scratch in every scene.

The loading screen times have been ​greatly​ reduced.

Two achievements have been fixed:
-The Potion Addict achievement was being given but not under the right circumstances.
-Another (hidden) achievement it turns out was not being given at all.
-Both of these are now working as intended.

A few small bugs and continuity errors were fixed.
